headline: Approved all 13 library branch manager job applications that had been tabled earlier.
summary: Approved all 13 library branch manager job applications that had been tabled earlier. Discussed the NeoGov applicant tracking system for Civil Service review. A motion to table the 8.20.2026 regular meeting minutes was made, with no result recorded.
decisions: Approved all 13 library branch manager job applications; the motion passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ward motioned to approve all 13 Library Branch Manager applications. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward. 
Staff in attendance: Jordanne Bryan-Haynes, J. Susy Diaz-Callands, Bobbye Peterson,

 None.

 None.
